flavor.gold: The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.
flavor.silver: It carries a seed on its back right from birth. As it grows older, the seed also grows larger.

flavor.gold: Exposure to sun light adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.
flavor.silver: If the bud on its back starts to smell sweet, it is evidence that the large flower will soon bloom.

flavor.gold: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.
flavor.silver: It is able to con vert sunlight into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.

flavor.gold: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.
flavor.silver: The flame on its tail indicates CHARMANDER's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

flavor.gold: It is very hot headed by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.
flavor.silver: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

flavor.gold: If CHARIZARD be comes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a whitish- blue color.
flavor.silver: Breathing intense, hot flames, it can melt almost any thing. Its breath inflicts terrible pain on enemies.

flavor.gold: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prod ding fingers will bounce off it.
flavor.silver: The shell, which hardens soon after it is born, is resilient. If you poke it, it will bounce back out.

flavor.gold: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.
flavor.silver: It cleverly con trols its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

flavor.gold: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can with stand the recoil of the water jets it fires.
flavor.silver: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punch ing holes through thick steel.

flavor.gold: For protection, it releases a horri ble stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.
flavor.silver: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

flavor.gold: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it pre pares to evolve. It stays motion less in the shell.
flavor.silver: It prepares for evolution by har dening its shell as much as possi ble to protect its soft body.

flavor.gold: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
flavor.silver: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heav iest of rains.

flavor.gold: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.
flavor.silver: It attacks using a two-inch poison barb on its head. It can usually be found under the leaves it eats.

flavor.gold: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.
flavor.silver: From this form, it will grow into an adult. As its body becomes soft er, the external shell hardens.

flavor.gold: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poi son stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.
flavor.silver: It has three poison barbs. The barb on its tail secretes the most powerful poison.

flavor.gold: It usually hides in tall grass. Be cause it dislikes fighting, it pro tects itself by kicking up sand.
flavor.silver: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flap ping up sand.

flavor.gold: It has outstanding vision. However high it flies, it is able to distin guish the move ments of its prey.
flavor.silver: It immobilizes its prey using well- developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

flavor.gold: Its well-developed chest muscles make it strong enough to whip up a gusty windstorm with just a few flaps.
flavor.silver: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

flavor.gold: It eats anything. Wherever food is available, it will settle down and produce offspring continuously.
flavor.silver: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scav enges for edibles the entire day.

flavor.gold: Gnaws on anything with its tough fangs. It can even topple concrete buildings by gnaw ing on them.
flavor.silver: Its whiskers help it to maintain balance. Its fangs never stop grow ing, so it gnaws to pare them down.

flavor.gold: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.
flavor.silver: Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.

flavor.gold: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.
flavor.silver: It cleverly uses its thin, long beak to pluck and eat small insects that hide under the ground.

flavor.gold: It can freely de tach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can be come too heavy to move, however.
flavor.silver: It always hides in grass. When first born, it has no poison, so its bite is painful, but harmless.

flavor.gold: Transfixing prey with the face-like pattern on its belly, it binds and poisons the frightened victim.
flavor.silver: With a very venge ful nature, it won't give up the chase, no matter how far, once it targets its prey.

flavor.gold: This intelligent POKéMON roasts hard BERRIES with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
flavor.silver: It raises its tail to check its sur roundings. The tail is sometimes struck by light ning in this pose.

flavor.gold: When its electric ity builds, its muscles are stimu lated, and it be comes more aggres sive than usual.
flavor.silver: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

flavor.gold: If it fell from a great height, this POKéMON could save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.
flavor.silver: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

flavor.gold: In an attempt to hide itself, it will run around at top speed to kick up a blinding dust storm.
flavor.silver: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spikes and claws. They grow back in a day.

flavor.gold: The poison hidden in its small horn is extremely po tent. Even a tiny scratch can have fatal results.
flavor.silver: Although not very combative, it will torment its foes with poison spikes if it is threat ened in any way.

flavor.gold: When feeding its young, it first chews and tender izes the food, then spits it out for the offspring.
flavor.silver: It has a calm and caring nature. Because its horn grows slowly, it prefers not to fight.

flavor.gold: Its body is cover ed with needle- like scales. It never shows signs of shrinking from any attack.
flavor.silver: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

flavor.gold: It is small, but its horn is filled with poison. It charges then stabs with the horn to inject poison.
flavor.silver: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. It will strike first if it senses any danger.

flavor.gold: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses any thing, it attacks immediately.
flavor.silver: Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with its horn to inject a powerful poison when it becomes agitated.

flavor.gold: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.
flavor.silver: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can snap the victim's spine quite easily.

flavor.gold: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.
flavor.silver: Its adorable be havior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute POKéMON is rarely found.

flavor.gold: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.
flavor.silver: Its very sensitive ears lets it dis tinguish distant sounds. As a re sult, it prefers quiet places.

flavor.gold: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.
flavor.silver: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

flavor.gold: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.
flavor.silver: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

flavor.gold: If it inflates to SING a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.
flavor.silver: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.

flavor.gold: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won't want to be separated.
flavor.silver: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a BODY SLAM.

flavor.gold: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its sur roundings.
flavor.silver: Capable of flying safely in dark places, it emits ultrasonic cries to check for any obstacles.

flavor.gold: However hard its victim's hide may be, it punctures with sharp fangs and gorges itself with blood.
flavor.silver: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

flavor.gold: Awakened by moon light, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.
flavor.silver: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

flavor.gold: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
flavor.silver: It secretes a sticky, drool-like honey. Although sweet, it smells too repulsive to get very close.

flavor.gold: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
flavor.silver: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poi sonous pollen.

flavor.gold: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.
flavor.silver: As its body grows large, oriental mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.

flavor.gold: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mush rooms on its back.
flavor.silver: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mush room spores it scatters.

flavor.gold: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.
flavor.silver: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches and eats small bugs at night that are at tracted by light.

flavor.gold: When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poi sonous powder all around.
flavor.silver: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in color. If it is light, it causes paralysis.

flavor.gold: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.
flavor.silver: If a DIGLETT DIGS through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

flavor.gold: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
flavor.silver: Extremely power ful, they can DIG through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

flavor.gold: It is fascinated by round objects. It can't stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.
flavor.silver: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and se cretly hoards.

flavor.gold: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.
flavor.silver: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

flavor.gold: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.
flavor.silver: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

flavor.gold: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its fore head somehow be gins to glow.
flavor.silver: It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use tele kinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.

flavor.gold: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.
flavor.silver: It's unsafe to ap proach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can't distinguish friends from foes.

flavor.gold: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.
flavor.silver: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

flavor.gold: It has a brave and trustworthy na ture. It fear lessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
flavor.silver: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any oppo nent to protect its own trainer from harm.

flavor.gold: This legendary Chinese POKEMON is considered magnif icent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.
flavor.silver: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.

flavor.gold: Because it is in ept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.
flavor.silver: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.

flavor.gold: The swirl on its belly subtly un dulates. Staring at it may gradual ly cause drowsi ness.
flavor.silver: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

flavor.gold: This strong and skilled swimmer is even capable of crossing the Pacific Ocean just by kicking.
flavor.silver: Although an ener getic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its mus cles, it lives on dry land.

flavor.gold: It senses impend ing attacks and TELEPORTS away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.
flavor.silver: If it decides to TELEPORT randomly, it creates the illusion that it has created copies of itself.

flavor.gold: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.
flavor.silver: If it uses its abilities, it emits special alpha waves that cause machines to malfunction.

flavor.gold: Closing both its eyes heightens all its other senses. This enables it to use its abilities to their extremes.
flavor.silver: Its brain cells multiply continu ally until it dies. As a result, it remembers everything.

flavor.gold: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.
flavor.silver: It loves to work out and build its muscles. It is never satisfied, even if it trains hard all day long.

flavor.gold: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable POKéMON never gets tired.
flavor.silver: The muscles cover ing its body teem with power. Even when still, it exudes an amazing sense of strength.

flavor.gold: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
flavor.silver: It uses its four powerful arms to pin the limbs of its foe, then throws the victim over the horizon.

flavor.gold: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
flavor.silver: It plants its feet deep underground to replenish wa ter. It can't es cape its enemy while it's rooted.

flavor.gold: Even though it is filled with ACID, it does not melt because it also oozes a neutral izing fluid.
flavor.silver: If its prey is bigger than its mouth, it slices up the victim with sharp leaves, then eats every morsel.

flavor.gold: ACID that has dis solved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.
flavor.silver: This horrifying plant POKéMON at tracts prey with aromatic honey, then melts them in its mouth.

flavor.gold: When the tide goes out, dehydrated TENTACOOL remains can be found washed up on the shore.
flavor.silver: It drifts aimless ly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.

flavor.gold: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to CON STRICT its prey and enemies.
flavor.silver: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its oppo nent inside a poisonous net.

flavor.gold: Most people may not notice, but a closer look should reveal that there are many GEODUDE around.
flavor.silver: It uses its arms to steadily climb steep mountain paths. It swings its fists around if angered.

flavor.gold: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
flavor.silver: A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no attention to any object that happens to be in its path.

flavor.gold: It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hard ens and crumbles away.
flavor.silver: It is capable of blowing itself up. It uses this explosive force to jump from mountain to mountain.

flavor.gold: It is a weak run ner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.
flavor.silver: Its hind legs, which have hard er-than-diamond hooves, kick back at any presence it senses behind it.

flavor.gold: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredi bly fast.
flavor.silver: With incredible acceleration, it reaches its top speed of 150 mph after running just ten steps.

flavor.gold: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.
flavor.silver: A sweet sap leaks from its tail's tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.

flavor.gold: If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordi nary SLOWPOKE.
flavor.silver: Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to SHELLDER's seeping poison.

flavor.gold: It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach trainers if they are using their POKéGEAR.
flavor.silver: The units at the sides of its body generate anti gravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.

flavor.gold: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.
flavor.silver: The MAGNEMITE are united by a mag netism so power ful, it dries all moisture in its vicinities.

flavor.gold: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant sticks grow, it uses its own stick to thwart them.
flavor.silver: If it eats the plant stick it carries as emer gency rations, it runs off in search of a new stick.

flavor.gold: By alternately raising and lower ing its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.
flavor.silver: It races through grassy plains with powerful strides, leaving footprints up to four inches deep.

flavor.gold: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and be come immobilized.
flavor.silver: If one of the heads gets to eat, the others will be satisfied, too, and they will stop squabbling.

flavor.gold: Although it can't walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It espe cially loves being in frigid seas.
flavor.silver: In daytime, it is often found asleep on the seabed in shallow waters. Its nostrils close while it swims.

flavor.gold: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.
flavor.silver: It loves frigid seas with ice floes. It uses its long tail to change swimming direction quickly.

flavor.gold: As it moves, it loses bits of its body from which new GRIMER emerge. This worsens the stench around it.
flavor.silver: Wherever GRIMER has passed, so many germs are left behind that no plants will ever grow again.

flavor.gold: They love to gath er in smelly areas where sludge ac cumulates, making the stench around them worse.
flavor.silver: Its body is made of a powerful poi son. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.

flavor.gold: It swims facing backward by open ing and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
flavor.silver: Grains of sand trapped in its shells mix with its body fluids to form beautiful pearls.

flavor.gold: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superi or strength.
flavor.silver: CLOYSTER that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

flavor.gold: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
flavor.silver: Its thin body is made of gas. It can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

flavor.gold: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, HAUNTER lurks, silently stalking its next victim.
flavor.silver: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death even tually comes.

flavor.gold: It steals heat from its surround ings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.
flavor.silver: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

flavor.gold: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.
flavor.silver: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its mas sive, rugged body.

flavor.gold: If you think that you had a good dream, but you can't remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.
flavor.silver: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

flavor.gold: When it is very hungry, it puts humans it meets to sleep, then it feasts on their dreams.
flavor.silver: Always holding a pendulum that it rocks at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in any one nearby.

flavor.gold: If it senses dan ger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
flavor.silver: The pincers break off easily. If it loses a pincer, it somehow becomes incapable of walk ing sideways.

flavor.gold: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincer's size makes it difficult to aim properly.
flavor.silver: Its pincers grow peculiarly large. If it lifts the pincers too fast, it loses its bal ance and staggers.

flavor.gold: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.
flavor.silver: It was discovered when POKé BALLS were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

flavor.gold: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.
flavor.silver: It stores an over flowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

flavor.gold: The shell is very durable. Even if it cracks, it can survive without spilling the contents.
flavor.silver: Using telepathy only they can receive, they always form a cluster of six EXEGGCUTE.

flavor.gold: Its three heads think independent ly. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
flavor.silver: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an EXEGGCUTE cluster.

flavor.gold: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes, and emits a plain tive and mournful sound.
flavor.silver: It always wears the skull of its dead mother, so no one has any idea what its hidden face looks like.

flavor.gold: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out mes sages to others.
flavor.silver: It collects bones from an unknown place. A MAROWAK graveyard exists somewhere in the world, rumors say.

flavor.gold: This amazing POKé MON has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
flavor.silver: If it starts kick ing repeatedly, both legs will stretch even long er to strike a fleeing foe.

flavor.gold: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
flavor.silver: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

flavor.gold: Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deft ly manipulated.
flavor.silver: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to any thing, so it is very useful.

flavor.gold: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.
flavor.silver: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air, keeping it slight ly airborne.

flavor.gold: If one of the twin KOFFING inflates, the other one deflates. It con stantly mixes its poisonous gases.
flavor.silver: Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the high est level.

flavor.gold: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.
flavor.silver: It doesn't care if there is anything in its way. It just charges and destroys all ob stacles.

flavor.gold: Its rugged hide protects it from even the heat of lava. However, the hide also makes it insensitive.
flavor.silver: Its brain devel oped when it began walking on hind legs. Its thick hide protects it even in magma.

flavor.gold: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.
flavor.silver: Few in number and difficult to cap ture, it is said to bring happiness to the trainer who catches it.

flavor.gold: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively un nerve its foes.
flavor.silver: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

flavor.gold: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.
flavor.silver: To protect its young, it will never give up during battle, no matter how badly wounded it is.

flavor.gold: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its dorsal fin.
flavor.silver: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.

flavor.gold: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in HORSEA. It became a hot topic.
flavor.silver: Its fin-tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

flavor.gold: Its dorsal, pecto ral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.
flavor.silver: A strong swimmer, it is capable of swimming nonstop up fast streams at a steady speed of five knots.

flavor.gold: During spawning season, SEAKING gather from all over, coloring the rivers a brilliant red.
flavor.silver: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

flavor.gold: At night, the cen ter of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.
flavor.silver: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core re mains intact.

flavor.gold: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a dif ferent color each time it is seen.
flavor.silver: Regardless of the environment it lives in, its body grows to form a symmetrical geo metric shape.

flavor.gold: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisi ble objects as it matures.
flavor.silver: Its fingertips emit a peculiar force field that hardens air to create an actual wall.

flavor.gold: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.
flavor.silver: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its pro tective colors make it invisible.

flavor.gold: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depend ing on how it is feeling.
flavor.silver: It speaks a lan guage similar to that of humans. However, it seems to use dancing to communicate.

flavor.gold: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its en tire body glows a whitish-blue.
flavor.silver: Its body constant ly discharges electricity. Get ting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

flavor.gold: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suit able for itself.
flavor.silver: The fiery surface of its body gives off a wavering, rippling glare that is similar to the sun.

flavor.gold: With its horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.
flavor.silver: Swings its long antlers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

flavor.gold: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its bat tle-scarred horns.
flavor.silver: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

flavor.gold: An underpowered, pathetic POKéMON. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.
flavor.silver: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like PIDGEOTTO to catch it mid-jump.

flavor.gold: They say that during past wars, GYARADOS would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.
flavor.silver: Once it appears, it goes on a ram page. It remains enraged until it demolishes every thing around it.

flavor.gold: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their num ber has dwindled.
flavor.silver: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

flavor.gold: It can transform into anything. When it sleeps, it changes into a stone to avoid being attacked.
flavor.silver: Its transformation ability is per fect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

flavor.gold: It has the ability to alter the com position of its body to suit its surrounding envi ronment.
flavor.silver: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its en vironment changes.

flavor.gold: When VAPOREON's fins begin to vi brate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.
flavor.silver: It prefers beauti ful shores. With cells similar to water molecules, it could melt in water.

flavor.gold: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.
flavor.silver: Every hair on its body starts to stand sharply on end if it becomes charged with electricity.

flavor.gold: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees.
flavor.silver: It fluffs out its fur collar to cool down its body temperature, which can reach 1,650 degrees.

flavor.gold: It is a manmade POKéMON. Since it doesn't breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment.
flavor.silver: A manmade POKéMON that came about as a result of re search. It is pro grammed with only basic motions.

flavor.gold: Revived from an ancient fossil, this POKéMON uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.
flavor.silver: This POKéMON from ancient times is said to have navi gated the sea by adeptly twisting its 10 tentacles.

flavor.gold: Apparently, it cracked SHELLDER's shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.
flavor.silver: Once wrapped around its prey, it never lets go. It eats the prey by tearing at it with sharp fangs.

flavor.gold: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.
flavor.silver: This POKéMON lived in ancient times. On rare occasions, it has been discovered as a living fossil.

flavor.gold: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.
flavor.silver: With sharp claws, this ferocious, ancient POKéMON rips apart prey and sucks their body fluids.

flavor.gold: A vicious POKéMON from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.
flavor.silver: This vicious POKé MON is said to have flown in an cient skies while shrieking high- pitched cries.

flavor.gold: What sounds like its cry may ac tually be its snores or the rumblings of its hungry belly.
flavor.silver: Its stomach's di gestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. It can even eat things off the ground.

flavor.gold: The magnificent, seemingly translu cent wings of this legendary bird POKéMON are said to be made of ice.
flavor.silver: One of the legen dary bird POKéMON, it chills moisture in the atmosphere to create snow while flying.

flavor.gold: This legendary bird POKéMON causes savage thunderstorms by flapping its glit tering wings.
flavor.silver: This legendary bird POKéMON is said to appear only when a thun dercloud parts into two halves.

flavor.gold: This legendary POKéMON scatters embers with every flap of its wings. It is a thrilling sight to behold.
flavor.silver: This legendary bird POKéMON is said to bring early spring to the wintry lands it visits.

flavor.gold: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.
flavor.silver: This POKéMON is full of life ener gy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

flavor.gold: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.
flavor.silver: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this POKéMON the power to freely control the weather.

flavor.gold: It is said that this POKéMON con stantly flies over the immense seas and rescues drown ing people.
flavor.silver: This marine POKé MON has an impres sive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.

flavor.gold: Because its battle abilities were raised to the ultimate level, it thinks only of de feating its foes.
flavor.silver: It usually remains motionless to con serve energy, so that it may un leash its full power in battle.

flavor.gold: Apparently, it appears only to those people who are pure of heart and have a strong desire to see it.
flavor.silver: Its DNA is said to contain the genet ic codes of all POKéMON, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

flavor.gold: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.
flavor.silver: Its pleasantly aromatic leaves have the ability to check the hu midity and tem perature.

flavor.gold: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.
flavor.silver: A spicy aroma ema nates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to re store health.

flavor.gold: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.
flavor.silver: MEGANIUM's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

flavor.gold: It is timid, and always curls it self up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
flavor.silver: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

flavor.gold: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.
flavor.silver: This POKéMON is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

flavor.gold: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
flavor.silver: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blaz ing fur together to cause huge explosions.

flavor.gold: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.
flavor.silver: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

flavor.gold: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
flavor.silver: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

flavor.gold: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
flavor.silver: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

flavor.gold: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
flavor.silver: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

flavor.gold: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.
flavor.silver: There is no tell ing where the tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunt ing RATTATA.

flavor.gold: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
flavor.silver: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

flavor.gold: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
flavor.silver: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 de grees to sharpen its intellectual power.

flavor.gold: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
flavor.silver: When the weather turns cold, lots of LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

flavor.gold: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
flavor.silver: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

flavor.gold: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
flavor.silver: It spins a web using fine--but durable--thread. It then waits pa tiently for prey to be trapped.

flavor.gold: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
flavor.silver: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.

flavor.gold: It flies so si lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
flavor.silver: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

flavor.gold: It shoots positive and negative elec tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
flavor.silver: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communi cation is its constantly flash ing lights.

flavor.gold: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
flavor.silver: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

flavor.gold: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
flavor.silver: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

flavor.gold: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
flavor.silver: When numerous me teors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.

flavor.gold: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
flavor.silver: Its extremely flexible and elas tic body makes it bounce continuous ly--anytime, any where.

flavor.gold: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
flavor.silver: A proverb claims that happiness will come to any one who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.

flavor.gold: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, car ing people and shower them with happiness.
flavor.silver: It grows dispirit ed if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

flavor.gold: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star ing at something.
flavor.silver: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

flavor.gold: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
flavor.silver: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

flavor.gold: If static elec tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
flavor.silver: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

flavor.gold: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
flavor.silver: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

flavor.gold: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
flavor.silver: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

flavor.gold: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
flavor.silver: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

flavor.gold: The tip of its tail, which con tains oil that is lighter than wa ter, lets it swim without drowning.
flavor.silver: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

flavor.gold: By keeping still and listening in tently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.
flavor.silver: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from get ting wet.

flavor.gold: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composi tion appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.
flavor.silver: It disguises it self as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

flavor.gold: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather ing from far and wide.
flavor.silver: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

flavor.gold: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.
flavor.silver: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

flavor.gold: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc tuates up and down.
flavor.silver: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

flavor.gold: Once it catches the wind, it deft ly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.
flavor.silver: Drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

flavor.gold: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
flavor.silver: It lives atop tall trees. When leap ing from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

flavor.gold: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
flavor.silver: It lives by drink ing only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

flavor.gold: It converts sun light into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
flavor.silver: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a com plete stop when the sun sets.

flavor.gold: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter win dows in the area.
flavor.silver: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

flavor.gold: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
flavor.silver: When it walks a round on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

flavor.gold: This carefree POKéMON has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
flavor.silver: Due to its relaxed and carefree atti tude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

flavor.gold: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its ene my's actions.
flavor.silver: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weath er or its foe's next move.

flavor.gold: When agitated, this POKéMON pro tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
flavor.silver: When darkness falls, the rings on the body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

flavor.gold: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
flavor.silver: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

flavor.gold: It has incredible intellect and in tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
flavor.silver: When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

flavor.gold: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
flavor.silver: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

flavor.gold: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tab lets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
flavor.silver: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some mean ing.

flavor.gold: It hates light and shock. If attack ed, it inflates its body to pump up its counter strike.
flavor.silver: To keep its pitch- black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

flavor.gold: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.
flavor.silver: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.

flavor.gold: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.
flavor.silver: It hangs and waits for flying insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

flavor.gold: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.
flavor.silver: It remains immova bly rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

flavor.gold: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes backward by furi ously boring into the ground with its tail.
flavor.silver: If spotted, it es capes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

flavor.gold: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star tled victim to inject poison.
flavor.silver: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

flavor.gold: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
flavor.silver: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

flavor.gold: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
flavor.silver: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its af fectionate ways.

flavor.gold: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
flavor.silver: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its BITE is powerful.

flavor.gold: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
flavor.silver: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They in ject a toxin that causes fainting.

flavor.gold: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
flavor.silver: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

flavor.gold: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
flavor.silver: It stores BERRIES inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

flavor.gold: This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.
flavor.silver: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

flavor.gold: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
flavor.silver: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.

flavor.gold: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.
flavor.silver: Before food be comes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hid den locations.

flavor.gold: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.
flavor.silver: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfail ingly finds all food buried deep underground.

flavor.gold: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
flavor.silver: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a con stant search for warm places.

flavor.gold: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
flavor.silver: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that cir culate throughout its body.

flavor.gold: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
flavor.silver: If it smells some thing enticing, it dashes headlong off to find the source of the aroma.

flavor.gold: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.
flavor.silver: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensi tive to sound.

flavor.gold: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.
flavor.silver: In a south sea nation, the people live in communi ties that are built on groups of these POKéMON.

flavor.gold: It has superb ac curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.
flavor.silver: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a MANTINE's under side to scavenge for leftovers.

flavor.gold: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
flavor.silver: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fel low OCTILLERY.

flavor.gold: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
flavor.silver: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its await ing chicks.

flavor.gold: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
flavor.silver: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

flavor.gold: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
flavor.silver: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

flavor.gold: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
flavor.silver: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

flavor.gold: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.
flavor.silver: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other POKéMON get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

flavor.gold: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
flavor.silver: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

flavor.gold: It swings its long snout around play fully, but because it is so strong, that can be dan gerous.
flavor.silver: As a sign of af fection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

flavor.gold: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.
flavor.silver: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

flavor.gold: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.
flavor.silver: Further research enhanced its abil ities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

flavor.gold: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where real ity is distorted.
flavor.silver: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

flavor.gold: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.
flavor.silver: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

flavor.gold: It is always bursting with en ergy. To make it self stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
flavor.silver: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target with out warning.

flavor.gold: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.
flavor.silver: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

flavor.gold: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
flavor.silver: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and for wards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

flavor.gold: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.
flavor.silver: Even in the most vicious storm, this POKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

flavor.gold: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
flavor.silver: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temp. is over 1100 degrees, so don't under estimate it.

flavor.gold: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.
flavor.silver: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces con tains much more nutrition than usual.

flavor.gold: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg be comes unfailingly caring and pleas ant to everyone.
flavor.silver: It has a very com passionate nature. If it sees a sick POKéMON, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.

flavor.gold: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
flavor.silver: A POKéMON that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

flavor.gold: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.
flavor.silver: A POKéMON that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

flavor.gold: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
flavor.silver: This POKéMON races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow when ever it appears.

flavor.gold: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
flavor.silver: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

flavor.gold: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
flavor.silver: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has out standing destruc tive power.

flavor.gold: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
flavor.silver: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

flavor.gold: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
flavor.silver: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

flavor.gold: Legends claim this POKéMON flies the world's skies con tinuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.
flavor.silver: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

flavor.gold: This POKéMON wan ders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
flavor.silver: When CELEBI disap pears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.
